properties.rationale: Deferred on the established disposition for this review, 2026-07-28. Accepted and not dropped, and distinct from the rest of the batch in provenance: it comes from ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010 rather than from reflow, which had no equivalent. Deferred because the shape is a genuine fork, not a schedule: either correspondence rules become AUTHORABLE DATA (a predicate over node types, properties and edges, evaluated by the existing detector machinery) — powerful, and the thing that would let a team state a rule the maintainer never imagined — or they stay code and only the VOCABULARY becomes explicit, which is cheaper and safer. The first raises a question dec:report-dont-judge would have to answer: a user-authored rule must not become a way to make the tool assert something nobody checked. Also entangled with req:scenarios-are-modelled, since both want Actor to grow up from a line in report.rs's SNAPSHOT_TYPES into something read, and with Requirement.concern, which is dead precisely because no stakeholder-concern-viewpoint chain consumes it.
